chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Imagine you happen across a short movie script that describes a scene between a person and

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: their AI assistant.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The script has what the person asks the AI, but the AI's response has been torn off.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Suppose you also have this powerful magical machine that can take any text and provide

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: a sensible prediction of what word comes next.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: You could then finish the script by feeding in what you have to the machine, seeing what

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: it would predict to start the AI's answer, and then repeating this over and over with

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: a growing script completing the dialogue.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: When you interact with a chatbot, this is exactly what's happening.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: A large language model is a sophisticated mathematical function that predicts what word

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: comes next for any piece of text.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Instead of predicting one word with certainty, though, what it does is assign a probability

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: to all possible next words.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: To build a chatbot, you lay out some text that describes an interaction between a user

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: and a hypothetical AI assistant, you add on whatever the user types in as the first part

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: of that interaction, and then you have the model repeatedly predict the next word that

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: such a hypothetical AI assistant would say in response, and that's what's presented to

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: the user.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: In doing this, the output tends to look a lot more natural if you allow it to select

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: less likely words along the way at random.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: What this means is even though the model itself is deterministic, a given prompt typically

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: gives a different answer each time it's run.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Models learn how to make these predictions by processing an enormous amount of text,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: typically pulled from the internet.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: For a standard human to read the amount of text that was used to train GPT-3, for example,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: if they read non-stop 24-7, it would take over 2600 years.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Larger models since then train on much, much more.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: You can think of training a little bit like tuning the dials on a big machine.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The way a language model behaves is entirely determined by these many different continuous

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: values, usually called parameters or weights.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Changing those parameters will change the probabilities that the model gives for the

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: next word on a given input.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: What puts the large in large language model is how they can have hundreds of billions

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: of these parameters.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: No human ever deliberately sets those parameters.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Instead they begin at random, meaning the model just outputs gibberish, but are repeatedly

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: refined based on many example pieces of text.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: One of these training examples could be just a handful of words, or it could be thousands,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: but in either case the way this works is to pass in all but the last word from that example

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: into the model, and compare the prediction it makes with the true last word from the

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: example.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: An algorithm called backpropagation is used to tweak all of the parameters in such a way

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: that it makes the model a little more likely to choose the true last word, and a little

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: less likely to choose all the others.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: When you do this for many, many trillions of examples, not only does the model start

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: to give more accurate predictions on the training data, but it also starts to make more reasonable

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: predictions on text it's never seen before.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Given the huge number of parameters and the enormous amount of training data, the scale

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: of computation involved in training a large language model is mind-boggling.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: To illustrate, imagine you could perform 1 billion additions and multiplications every

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: single second.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: How long do you think it would take for you to do all of the operations involved in training

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: the largest language models?

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Do you think it would take a year?

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Maybe something like 10,000 years?

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The answer is actually much more than that.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: It's well over 100 million years.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: This is only part of the story, though.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: This whole process is called pre-training.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The goal of auto-completing a random passage of text from the internet is very different

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: from the goal of being a good AI assistant.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: To address this, chatbots undergo another type of training, just as important, called

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: reinforcement learning with human feedback.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Users flag unhelpful or problematic predictions, and their corrections further change the model's

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: parameters, making them more likely to give predictions that users prefer.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Looking back at the pre-training, this staggering amount of computation is only made possible

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: by using special computer chips that are optimized for running many, many operations in parallel,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: known as GPUs.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: However, not all language models can be easily parallelized.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Prior to 2017, most language models would process text one word at a time.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: But then, a team of researchers at Google introduced a new model known as the transformer.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Transformers don't read text from the start to the finish, they soak it all in at once,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: in parallel.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The very first step inside a transformer, and most other language models for that matter,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: is to associate each word with a long list of numbers.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: The reason for this is that the training process only works with continuous values,

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: so you have to somehow encode language using numbers, and each list of numbers may somehow

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: encode the meaning of the corresponding word.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: What makes transformers unique is their reliance on a special operation known as attention.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: This operation gives all of these lists of numbers a chance to talk to one another, and

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: refine the meanings they encode based on the context around, all done in parallel.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: For example, the numbers encoding the word bank might be changed based on the context

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: surrounding it to somehow encode the more specific notion of a river bank.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Transformers typically also include a second type of operation known as a feedforward neural

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: network, and this gives the model extra capacity to store more patterns about language learned

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: during training.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: All of this data repeatedly flows through many different iterations of these two fundamental

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: As it does so, the hope is that each list of numbers is enriched to encode whatever

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: information might be needed to make an accurate prediction of what word follows in the passage.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: At the end, one final function is performed on the last vector in this sequence, which

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: now has had a chance to be influenced by all the other context from the input text, as

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: well as everything the model learned during training, to produce a prediction of the next

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: word.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Now, the model's prediction looks like a probability for every possible next word.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Although researchers design the framework for how each of these steps work, it's important

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: to understand that the specific behavior is an emergent phenomenon based on how those

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: hundreds of billions of parameters are tuned during training.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: This makes it incredibly challenging to determine why the model makes the exact predictions

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: that it does.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: What you can see is that when you use large language model predictions to autocomplete

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: a prompt, the words that it generates are uncannily fluent, fascinating, and even useful.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: If you're a new viewer and you're curious about more details on how transformers and

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: attention work, boy do I have some material for you.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: One option is to jump into a series I made about deep learning, where we visualize and

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: motivate the details of attention and all the other steps in a transformer.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: But also, on my second channel I just posted a talk I gave a couple months ago about this

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: topic for the company TNG in Munich.

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: Sometimes I actually prefer the content I make as a casual talk rather than a produced

chunks.title: Large Language Models
chunks.text: video, but I leave it up to you which one of these feels like the better follow-on.
